''See also: [[Jai Chen Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Jai]] Chen is a member of the Jai clan{{!}}Jai family and the sister of [[Jai Long]]. A small, pale woman with long black hair, she is known for her distinctive powder-blue robes, which later incorporate the blue and burnt orange colors of the Twin Star Sect{{!}}Twin Star sect. She is a [[Truegold]] practitioner who utilizes a unique [[Path]] consisting of a blend of [[Hollow King]], Path of Grasping Sky{{!}}Grasping Sky, and [[Stellar Spear madra]], facilitated by a [[hunger artifact]]. Her power is manifested through a small, pink-tinged white [[dragon]] [[spirit]] named [[Fingerling]], which acts as an extension of her own abilities. Throughout her journey, [[Jai]] Chen has faced significant challenges, including periods of being trapped by the Jai Patriarch{{!}}Patriarch and struggling to control her [[madra]]. She has served as a founding member of the Twin Star Sect{{!}}Twin Star sect, where she is highly motivated to improve her skills, even hunting [[Remnants]] and rogue [[sacred beasts]] with a hunger spears{{!}}hunger spear gifted by [[Lindon]]. While her brother has often viewed her as someone who is not a primary fighter, she has demonstrated resolve and continues to develop her abilities independently of her companion [[spirit]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Jai]] Chen is a small woman who has been seen wearing lavender sacred artist's robe{{!}}sacred artist's robes stained with red liquid [[madra]]. She has also worn an outer robe of pale blue and burnt orange featuring the [[Twin Star]] logo.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|She has always been a stubborn and shy individual. Currently, she is in a state of grieving.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A [[Truegold]], her [[Path]] is a blend of [[Hollow King]], Path of Grasping Sky{{!}}Grasping Sky, and [[Stellar Spear madra]]. She utilizes her contracted [[spirit]] as a medium for techniques, such as unleashing a [[Striker technique]] with her pink-tinged serpentine [[dragon]]. Her powers include launching a net of pink [[madra]] from her hands and using the black dragon's breath{{!}}dragon's breath.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|“Channels…core, need…repaired. Expensive…elixir. Then…pure madra…for core.”<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|“It was a pleasure to meet you, Jai Chen,” Lindon said, without turning around.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|“I scanned him when he walked up. I don’t think he’s going to attack us.”<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Jai Chen steadied her feet and stretched out both hands. “Fingerling!” She and the dragon unleashed a basic Striker technique: a stream of madra that resembled Lindon’s dragon’s breath.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c17" />}}
